reports.title: OneSpaWorld Reports Record Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results

lines: Increases Fiscal 2026 Guidance to $1.033 to $1.038 Billion in Total Revenues and $138.0 to $140.0 Million in Adjusted EBITDA

Lazarus noted further, “We continued to execute our balanced capital allocation strategy, leveraging our strong cash flow generation and our positive outlook, to return $42.3 million to shareholders in the third quarter, including $37.2 million attributable to the repurchase of approximately 1.4 million common shares and $5.1 million via our quarterly dividend.

We now expect fiscal 2026 Total revenues to increase 10% and Adjusted EBITDA to increase 13% at the midpoints of our guidance ranges, compared with actual fiscal 2025 results, excluding exited and reorganized operations.

(2) The Company’s fiscal year 2026 guidance for the year ended December 31, 2026 as presented above compares to its previous guidance for Total revenues of $1.018 to $1.038 billion and Adjusted EBITDA of $130.0 to $140.0 million provided with second quarter 2026 results issued on July 29, 2026.
